howItWorks.title: How symbolic adoption works
howItWorks.intro: Adopting from a distance (or sponsoring) is a way to stand by one of our vultures and help us care for them.
howItWorks.symbolicText: The animal keeps living at the sanctuary, with the care they need. You support them from home.
howItWorks.stepChooseText: Browse the catalogue and choose the vulture you want to support.
howItWorks.stepPlanText: Pick a monthly fee. Every plan gives access to the same things.
howItWorks.stepNewsText: You will get an update with their photos and news at least every two weeks.

faq.manyAdoptersQ: Can an animal have several adopters?
faq.manyAdoptersA: Yes. A vulture can have as many adopters as want to support them, and you can adopt several animals.
faq.changePlanA: Yes, whenever you like. The new amount applies from the next fee.
faq.cancelA: From "My animals", at any time. The adoption stays active until the end of the month you have already paid.
faq.passedAwayQ: What happens if the animal dies?
faq.passedAwayA: We will let you know with care, the adoption will close with no further charges and you can carry on with another animal if you wish.

about.title: About the sanctuary
about.intro: We are a small sanctuary for vultures that, after an accident or an illness, can no longer survive in the wild.
about.historyText:
The sanctuary was born to give a permanent home to vultures rescued after being electrocuted on power lines, poisoned or hit by wind turbines. When a recovery centre cannot return them to the wild, they come here.

Each vulture has its own aviary, an adapted diet and the veterinary care it needs for the rest of its life. Symbolic adoptions and donations pay for part of that care.
about.visitsText: The sanctuary is not open to the public: that way the animals can live in peace. You can get to know them through their profiles and the news we publish.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.responsibleText: The Santuario de Animales is responsible for your data. You can write to us using the contact details in <0>About the sanctuary</0>.
privacy.dataText: When you create your account we keep your first name, surname, email, encrypted password and, if you give it to us, your phone number. When you adopt, we keep your adoptions, the chosen plan and the payments. We never keep card details: payments are simulated and, even if they were not, the payment gateway would handle them.
privacy.purposeText: To manage your account and your adoptions, to send you news about the animals you adopt and notices about your fees according to your profile preferences, and to show your name on an animal's profile only if you turn it on.
privacy.retentionText: As long as you have the account. If you ask to close it, we erase your personal data and only keep, without your name, the payments the law requires us to keep.
privacy.sharingText: Nobody. Everything is stored on the sanctuary's server and we do not use analytics or advertising services.
privacy.rightsText: You can view and correct your data in <0>My profile</0>. To erase it, object to its use or ask for a copy, write to us. If you think we are not handling it properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
privacy.cookiesText: What we store in your browser is explained in the <0>cookie policy</0>.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
